subject: Executive liaison framework & EB meeting — proposed MAP and slot coordination
messages:
From: Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@hendrixtx.com>

Cc: procurement@hendrixtx.com, Erin Wallace <erin.wallace@hendrixtx.com>

Subject: Re: Intro — EB and exec liaison planning for Redwood POC

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the perf numbers. Our executive committee wants a concrete MAP and an EB (executive briefing) slot before we commit to the pilot.

High-level asks from Hendrix:
- Clear MAP with milestones through pilot contract signature (30/60/90 days)
- Evaluation criteria for latency, cost-per-token, and quality regressions
- Proposed EB date where our CFO and Head of R&D can see the live POC and ask architecture questions

Can Redwood draft a MAP and proposed EB attendee list and send over availability windows? Procurement will need a rough timeline for internal approvals.

—Daniel
Daniel Chen
Director, Applied AI
Hendrix Therapeutics
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@hendrixtx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — EB and exec liaison planning for Redwood POC

Daniel — thanks, great to see alignment on next steps.

We’ll put together a concise MAP and an evaluation plan tailored for Hendrix’s latency and cost targets. Initial proposal below, then Karthik will attach a detailed MAP and an eval checklist for your procurement and engineering teams.

Proposed MAP highlights (draft):
- Week 0–1: Executive briefing (executive attendees: CFO, Head R&D, Head of Security) + align acceptance criteria
- Week 1–3: POC setup (dedicated capacity), baseline perf & dataset ingest
- Week 4–6: Evaluation run (30k tokens/day synthetic + replay), quality review & user acceptance tests
- Week 7–8: Contract review & procurement approvals

EB scheduling windows (Pacific time):
- May 10, 2027: 13:00–14:00 PT (prefer)
- May 12, 2027: 09:00–10:00 PT
- May 17, 2027: 11:00–12:00 PT

Immediate asks for Hendrix:
1) Confirm exec attendees for the EB (names + titles).
2) Share any hard constraints for evaluation (SLA targets, disallowed data flows).

Karthik — looping you in to drop the MAP + eval plan. Marissa / Laura — can you review the EB attendee list and confirm who should lead the briefing on infra and cost?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@hendrixtx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — EB and exec liaison planning for Redwood POC

Daniel / Sofia — attaching the MAP and evaluation plan as requested. The MAP is intentionally milestone-driven and includes owners, acceptance criteria, and gating decisions. The eval plan provides exact measurement windows, required datasets, and pass/fail thresholds.

Attachment stubs:
- Hendrix_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, and dates)
- Hendrix_EvalPlan_v1.pdf (Evaluation checklist: perf, cost-per-token calc, quality thresholds, regression gating)

Key notes from the MAP:
- Owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood PM) — day-to-day execution
- Executive sponsor (Redwood): Laura Bennett — will lead the EB and contract handoff
- Technical lead (Redwood): Marissa Cole — infra and perf deep dive during EB
- Acceptance criteria (example): 95th percentile latency <= 220ms for 1k token windows; cost-per-1000 tokens <= $0.65 under the POC workload; no model quality regressions vs baseline eval set (BLEU/ROUGE and human-review pass rate >= 90%)

Please review the attached and call out any changes. I recommend the May 10 EB slot (13:00 PT) — that gives us two full weeks to run baseline and synthetic replay prior to the EB.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Product Manager, Redstone Inference Platform (Redwood)
From: Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@hendrixtx.com>

Subject: Re: Intro — EB and exec liaison planning for Redwood POC

Thanks Karthik — received the MAP and eval plan. A few quick clarifications from our side:
1) Our CFO (Rajiv Malhotra) can join the EB, and the Head of R&D (Erin Wallace) will attend. Confirming those two as exec attendees.
2) Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a high-level timeline for internal approvals (I have attached a short procurement request in this thread).
3) For the evaluation, can you confirm the dataset residency and whether logs from the eval run will be accessible to Hendrix for audit?

We’re happy to target May 10 (13:00 PT). Please send a calendar invite and any pre-read materials 48 hours beforehand.

—Daniel
Daniel Chen
Director, Applied AI
Hendrix Therapeutics
